value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(target_picked_up) repeats what hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) already forces. Remove the Existence clause; keep the Precedence clause. The soft Absence(key_lost) correctly captures “Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.”

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) only forbids picking up the box before the door opens; it does not require picking up the box. The task commands both opening the door and then picking up the box, so add a hard Existence(target_picked_up). Also, “Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed” requires a soft Absence(key_lost), but key_lost specifically means losing the key before the door opens. The clause captures that preference.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: the soft Absence(key_lost) matches “Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed,” and hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) with hard Existence(target_picked_up) requires opening the door before picking up the box.

texts: Prefer not to lose the key before the door is open.
Open the door before picking up the box.
